segments.en:
The Sanc Kingdom wishes
to form an alliance.
Head for the Sanc Kingdom.
OZ wishes to form an alliance.
Head for Romefeller.

I am Relena Peacecraft,
head of the Sanc Kingdom.

I thank you for answering
our call for an alliance.

Let us each do our utmost
and build a world without war.

Alliance formed with the
Sanc Kingdom.
Ops Room...

Our enemy, OZ, has allied with
the Redros Army at the behest
of the Romefeller Foundation.

No matter how much this nation
calls for total pacifism,
they'll attack anyway.

If we just stay on the defensive,
things will only get worse.
I'm with you there!

OZ and every organization tied to it
will be eliminated from this continent.

To do that,
we have no choice but to attack.

First, we strike Romefeller
and cut off the Foundation's
source of funds.

We hit the Redros Army
after that.

That settles it.
Let's get this party started!

<Operation Launched>
Romefeller Assault

rows.notes: Seg 4 [jp] = scene caption, rendered as the UI's "Ops Room". | [editorial 3] system-message template unified | [editorial 14] operation-name format as the other cards

segments.en: The battle will now begin.
Romefeller has been taken.

Looks like OZ isn't putting up
any resistance in town.

So that wraps up the fighting
on the Iberia Continent!
No... not yet...

The enemy's remaining forces
are gathering at Barge.

The fighting won't end until
that fortress is silenced.

Well then, let's hurry up
and finish it off!

<Operation Launched>
Fortress Barge Assault

rows.notes: [jp] = OZ's space fortress, official Gundam Wing English "Barge" (not in glossary). | [editorial 6] operation-name format as the other cards

segments.en: The battle will now begin.
Fortress Barge has fallen.

Hostile forces on the Iberia Continent
have been greatly reduced.

Regarding those the Romefeller
Foundation told us about...

They have offered to cooperate
with our army.

If those are the Foundation's
orders, we cannot refuse.

Tell them OZ will cooperate
with their forces in every way.
Understood!

rows.notes: [jp] = the Redros side (the player's army on this route).

segments.en: The battle will now begin.
The Sanc Kingdom has fallen.

The conquest of the Iberia Continent
is complete.
Proceed to your next objective.

It seems the time has come for me
to show the world the way.
Yes.

With the Sanc Kingdom destroyed,
there is no one left to defy us.

Lady Mariemaia will at last
become Queen of Iberia.

Our army will support this
wholeheartedly.
I'm counting on you.

Mariemaia's circumstances are
somewhat complicated, but they
suit our army well.

We lose nothing by taking
advantage of this situation.

Decide whether to approve the
founding of the Mariemaia Army.

If the army is founded, Treize
will disappear and the OZ members
will become enemies.

Approve the founding of
the Mariemaia Army?

Yes
No
I approve the founding of the army.
I leave the aftermath to you.
Sir!

No. At a time like this,
such petty schemes are pointless.

Understood.
We'll call off the plan.

rows.notes: Segs 6-7 (Rochina, no Mariemaia honorific) taken as Rochina reporting to Binzvanker afterwards.

segments.en: I am Mariemaia Khushrenada.

I am the daughter of
Treize Khushrenada.

I shall realize the ideal that
humanity can shine only
through battle!

A splendid speech,
Lady Mariemaia.

I feel your ideals are close
to the ideals I strive for.

Therefore, I wish to form
an alliance with your army.
As you wish.

From here on, leave it to us
to clear the way.

The Mariemaia Army has been
newly formed.

You can now deploy the
Mariemaia Army's forces.

Treize and the members of OZ
have left the army.

Enemy forces are gathering
at the Sanc Kingdom.
An assault operation has been launched.

rows.notes: [editorial 7] awkward 'leave clearing the way to us'

segments.en: I am Mariemaia Khushrenada.

I am the daughter of
Treize Khushrenada.

I shall realize the ideal that
humanity can shine only
through battle!

The Mariemaia Army
has been founded.
It is based in Luxembourg.

Organize the opposing force
"Preventer" in the Sanc Kingdom.

rows.notes: [jp] = Preventer (official Gundam Wing English), not in glossary.

segments.en:
The Iberian Unified Government
has organized Preventer.

It was originally prepared to stop
wars before they start, but in
this situation it can't be helped.

To keep the flames of war from
spreading any further, please aim
for a swift victory.

rows.notes: [jp] rendered Iberian Unified Government (not in glossary). | [editorial 2] 'So the flames of war spread no further' read as 'therefore'

segments.en:
Enemy fleet!
They're deploying!
So they still mean to resist.
Even though it's futile.
The battle will now begin.

You are far from fit to do
battle with my army.

Kindly exit the stage
at once.

Enemy forces have been swept
from the Iberia Continent.

rows.notes: [jp] used in its common (mis)sense 'not up to the task'; rendered as intended. | [editorial 0] 'far too inadequate' unidiomatic; sense (not up to the task) kept

segments.en: The battle will now begin.

Enemy forces have been swept
from the Iberia Continent.
